title: feat(nsnnyin): nnseed y-probe own-lock-in exist-opposite: reverse fails, face fails
science: Own-lock-in on nnseed (perp seed +e1/+e2) y-probes. The seed letter L(A)=+e2 fills the empty S(A) but flips reverse only UNDEFINED -> fail, never to hold, because S^+(B)={+e1,+e3} has no -e2. Together with #7150 and #7159 this pins down the exact condition for the own-letter channel to fire: -L(A) must already lie in S^+(B).
